text:
matt: Heads up — customer restore failed with KMS Decrypt error. saw AccessDenied in restore logs.
security-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: restore-failure-high for tenant=acme-corp — KMSDecryptAccessDenied
matt: logs:
```
2026-03-22T14:03:12Z restore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-uploader is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```

tanya: any recent RBAC/role renames or IAM churn around backup uploader roles? @sam
sam: yes — rolled out role rename yesterday for the backup agents: `uploader` -> `backup-uploader`. policy was tightened. i thought grants were preserved but might have missed kms grants.
jia: fwiw i found leftover creds in `/tmp/backup-agent-creds` on staging last week during a vuln sweep. not sure prod tho. could be the agent runs with a different service role that never got the grant.
eng-oncall: tagging everyone — this looks like a grant-binding problem, not KMS outage. propose immediate mitigation steps.
ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-214 — assigned to eng-oncall and sec.

tanya: immediate action items:
1) check KMS grants for the CMK: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-backups`
2) confirm which principal is making Decrypt calls: CloudTrail event shows callerIdentity.
3) if missing, create grant with minimal usage: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-uploader --operations Decrypt` as stopgap.

sam: sharing the small policy snippet we tried to apply when renaming (might be the culprit):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::backups/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":"kms:CreateGrant","Resource":"*","Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:PrincipalIsAWSService":"false"}}}
  ]
}
```
sam: long story short, the deny on CreateGrant for non-service principals may have blocked the automated grant creation when the role was renamed.

jia: checking CloudTrail: i see `iam:UpdateRole` at 2026-03-21T23:45:12Z and `sts:AssumeRole` entries but no `kms:CreateGrant` event after the rename.
security-bot: CloudTrail search: eventId=evt-0a1b2c3d matched UpdateRole; no kms:CreateGrant found in 24h window.

matt: OK — mitigation plan: sam, can you create an explicit grant for `backup-uploader` and restart the restore job? eng-oncall will run a verification restore once grant exists.
sam: on it. creating grant now and will push a restart.

sam: quick command i ran (sanitized):
`aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-uploader --operations Decrypt` 
sam: created grant G-0x9abcd. restarted agent.
eng-oncall: running verification restore against a small snapshot now.

eng-oncall: verify: restore succeeded, decrypt OK. marking incident as mitigated for now. will keep incident open until postmortem.

matt: followups:
- rotate any temporary creds found in `/tmp` on staging/prod and audit for similar leftover files (jia)
- add a preflight check in the role-rename job to assert KMS grants exist for new principal (tanya)
- remove the overly-broad deny that blocked CreateGrant automation and add tests (sam)
- add CloudTrail alert for missing kms:CreateGrant when UpdateRole occurs (security)

jia: i rotated staging temp creds earlier today. will run a scan across prod infra for `/tmp/backup-agent*` patterns and report findings.

tanya: also adding to postmortem: clarify ownership of grant creation — automation vs manual, and add an approval gate if changing roles that touch CMKs.

eng-oncall: I will file the postmortem ticket and schedule a quick runbook update. @tanya @sam please include CLI snippets and the gated CI check. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-214 status -> mitigated. followup tasks assigned.

matt: thanks all. good catch on the deny policy. lesson: role renames must be atomic with grant rebind.
